questions.check: Does the boarding pass state the baggage allowance, e.g. '1 small bag on board'?
questions.say_example: The pass says <no checked bag>, but you added <one> at check-in. That won't match at the gate.

questions.question: Does the name on the boarding pass match the passenger you selected for check-in?
questions.why: The passenger selected for check-in and the name printed on the resulting boarding pass are different people.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user receives a boarding pass for the wrong person and will be unable to board their flight.
questions.check: What flight, date and passenger name does the issued boarding pass show, and do they match the flight and the passenger checked in?
questions.say_example: The pass reads <J. Marlow>. You checked in <K. Marlow>. That's a different passenger.

questions.question: Does the pass show a TSA PreCheck or other fast-track logo?
questions.why: Expedited security status is usually confirmed by a specific logo on the boarding pass; if it is missing, you must go back and add your Known Traveler Number before arriving at the airport.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the quick visual confirmation of your security status, which could result in waiting in the standard security line if a system glitch dropped your Known Traveler Number.
questions.check: Does the boarding pass display a TSA PreCheck or other expedited-security logo?
questions.say_example: There's no TSA PreCheck logo on this pass. If you're enrolled, you'd need to add your Known Traveler Number before you get to the airport.

children.label: Read the gate and boarding time

questions.question: Does the boarding time on the pass come before the departure time?
questions.why: Checking that the 1:35 PM boarding time is exactly 40 minutes before the 2:15 PM departure confirms the boarding pass details match your original itinerary.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to catch a potential system error where the generated boarding pass displays incorrect flight times.
questions.check: What boarding time and what departure time does the pass show?
questions.say_example: The pass shows boarding at <10:05 AM> for a departure of <9:45 AM>. Those two don't line up.

questions.question: What gate-closing time does the boarding pass show?
questions.why: Reviewing the final boarding pass details, such as the gate closing time and baggage allowance, ensures you have the correct information for your departure.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the immediate awareness of critical travel details like your specific gate closing time and exact baggage allowance.
questions.check: What gate-closing time does the boarding pass show?
questions.say_example: Gate closes at <12:20 PM>, separate from the boarding time

children.label: Collect the pass at the counter

questions.question: Does the page say the boarding pass has to be collected at the airport counter?
questions.why: The confirmation screen states that while check-in was successful, you must visit the airport counter to actually get your boarding pass.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: The user loses the immediate heads-up that they need to arrive at the airport early to visit the physical check-in counter.
questions.check: Does the confirmation say the boarding pass must be collected at an airport counter instead of online?
questions.say_example: Check-in went through, but the pass has to be collected at the airport counter. It won't appear online.

questions.question: Do the pre-flight reminders name anything you have to do before the flight?
questions.why: The screen displays final instructions about baggage, security, and boarding procedures before closing the check-in flow.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You miss the opportunity to review the airline's specific day-of-travel instructions regarding baggage and boarding.
questions.check: What actions does the pre-flight reminders section list (e.g. arrival time, ID to bring)?
questions.say_example: Logged the pre-flight reminders, which say <arrive two hours early> and <bring photo ID>

questions.question: Do the final details match the trip, and what does the page say about passport validity?
questions.why: The screen displays your final trip summary alongside a crucial warning about passport validity for British citizens traveling to the EU.
questions.whatTheAgentLoses: You lose the opportunity to personally verify your flight times and read important travel warnings regarding your passport.
questions.check: What flight details does the final summary show, and does the page warn about passport-validity requirements for the destination?
questions.say_example: Final summary matches, <Flight 402> on <Sept 22>. The page also says this passport needs <six months' validity> for the destination.
